# Beautyworld Dubai

## Where global beauty decides what's next

## The visitor registration is now live!

Beautyworld Dubai brings the global beauty supply chain together in the world's most connected trade
hub, Dubai. Every part of the beauty supply chain, fragrance, cosmetics, skincare, hair, beauty tech
and packaging, in one place, in one visit.

INTCO MEDICAL
INTCO Medical is one of the top disposable gloves manufacturers in the world and the world’s largest
manufacturer of non-latex disposable gloves. Publicly listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (Stock
Code: 300677), the company has an annual production capacity of over 103 billion gloves and leads
the global market in nitrile gloves and vinyl gloves. Its business spans medical consumables,
including nitrile gloves, vinyl gloves, synthetic latex gloves, masks, and other infection control
products; rehabilitation equipment, including wheelchairs and mobility aids; and physical therapy
products, including hot and cold therapy, first aid, cold chain, and pet care solutions. INTCO
Medical serves 15,000+ customers across 150+ countries, delivering reliable protection and
healthcare solutions worldwide.

INTCO MEDICAL
INTCO Medical is one of the top disposable gloves manufacturers in the world and the world’s largest
manufacturer of non-latex disposable gloves. Publicly listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (Stock
Code: 300677), the company has an annual production capacity of over 103 billion gloves and leads
the global market in nitrile gloves and vinyl gloves. Its business spans medical consumables,
including nitrile gloves, vinyl gloves, synthetic latex gloves, masks, and other infection control
products; rehabilitation equipment, including wheelchairs and mobility aids; and physical therapy
products, including hot and cold therapy, first aid, cold chain, and pet care solutions. INTCO
Medical serves 15,000+ customers across 150+ countries, delivering reliable protection and
healthcare solutions worldwide.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

large players of the Chinese market with a long history and excellent assortment, as well as small,
start-up companies or individuals. Sometimes it happens that sellers send poor quality products, do
not meet delivery times or even try to cheat.

There are frequent cases of deliberate deception of customers. For example, the tracking number is
incorrect or a low quality craft is sent. In the picture everything "looks like a million dollars",
but in fact a rag of a different color arrives.

suppliers on the Internet and build a rating with recommendations. We check thousands of items and
manufacturers every day, collect reviews buyers and reports from public sources. The algorithm

Xiantao Zhongtai Protective Products Co., Ltd

Xiantao Zhongtai Protective Products Co., Ltd. was founded in year 2003, as a professional
manufacturer of disposable nonwoven products. The factory covers an area of 7000 square meters, with
4 workshops, including dust-free workshop 600 square meters, 1 inspection laboratory, we can test
the uniformity, hydrostatic resistance and tensile force of the material, as well as the density of
dust particle, microorganism in workshop and sterile performance of products. We are specialized in
produce medical surgical gown, medical surgical kit, medical scrub suit, medical isolation gown,
medical patient gown, medical lab coat, medical coverall, medical face mask, medical head cover,
medical shoe cover etc.

committed to prioritizing the safety of medical personnel and patients everywhere. Through our
insights and product developments, we have equipped hospitals with regular supplies of medical
equipment and have bolstered national responses to outbreaks. See how our attentive production
process has helped us save lives.

* Zhongtai dedicate to becomes famous provider of disposable nonwoven products.

Xiantao Zhongtai Protective Products Co., Ltd

Xiantao Zhongtai Protective Products Co., Ltd. was founded in year 2003, as a professional
manufacturer of disposable nonwoven products. The factory covers an area of 7000 square meters, with
4 workshops, including dust-free workshop 600 square meters, 1 inspection laboratory, we can test
the uniformity, hydrostatic resistance and tensile force of the material, as well as the density of
dust particle, microorganism in workshop and sterile performance of products. We are specialized in
produce medical surgical gown, medical surgical kit, medical scrub suit, medical isolation gown,
medical patient gown, medical lab coat, medical coverall, medical face mask, medical head cover,
medical shoe cover etc.
* Happy Clients
* Top Ranking
* Certificate
* Favorable Rate
[About Us >][87]

Why Choose Us

Since 2003, Xiantao zhongtai has been at the forefront of manufacturing medical consumables and
committed to prioritizing the safety of medical personnel and patients everywhere. Through our
insights and product developments, we have equipped hospitals with regular supplies of medical
equipment and have bolstered national responses to outbreaks. See how our attentive production
process has helped us save lives.
* Our surgical gowns have a registration certificate, a production license and a free sale
  certificate.
* Zhongtai dedicate to becomes famous provider of disposable nonwoven products.
* We hope to build long run business relationship with you Welcome to inquiry us.
